lines.text: The root is Dict! Contradict, indicate.
Did you know? Dict is Latin for say.
Quick quiz! Which means into plus say?

words.ex: The new evidence contradicts earlier findings.
The results indicate that the plan is working.

publish.title: Dict root: contradict and indicate
publish.value: Dict comes from Latin "dicere" (to say). Words: contradict and indicate. contradict = contra + dict; indicate = in + dic.
